name: 06415 · Colchester, CT
findings: ZIP 06415 (Colchester) has 54 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06415 (Colchester) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
